turns.text: You people are thieves and liars. I will come to the studio and smash the frames if you ignore me.
I'm sorry you feel this way. I have passed your case to a colleague, who will take over from here. I can't accept threats. If you share your order number and email, it will help my colleague.

input.summary: Customer is angry, calls the shop thieves and liars, and threatens to come to the studio and smash the frames. No order number or email given and no request stated. A colleague should take over.
